title: Optimizer overlays, dossiers, and campaign generator
objective: Implement sparse authenticated hotness overlays, exact-region dossiers, transparent eligibility/ranking, and deterministic campaign task plans using existing parallel contracts

oracles: Sparse static/runtime mismatch fixtures, deterministic dossier obligations, and synthetic parallel campaign projections

handoff.summary: Implemented sparse exact-region hotness overlays with sample conservation and fail-closed stale or ambiguous joins; exact-region dossiers with complete detached optimizer IR, obligations, negative evidence, and held-out hypotheses; and deterministic dry-run campaign projections with path-aware claim, dependency-DAG, and shared-integration ownership validation. Producer and schema boundaries are injected so this lane does not duplicate the shared identity or schema foundation.
risks: Integration must supply one narrow adapter from the final dashboard and profiler receipt shapes to the foundation validators; this lane deliberately contains no duplicate identity or schema implementation.
Eligibility-specific stable reason codes must be mapped through that adapter to the final reason registry; the fixture adapter is synthetic test evidence only.
Campaign task contracts are dry-run projections; integration must validate them with the repository task schema and parallel:new before exposing an execution path.
next_steps: Merge engine-foundation, engine-dashboard-identity, and engine-profiler before this lane, then implement the integration-owned adapter and package-script wiring.
Run the overlay and dossier pipeline on authenticated current-source profiles and preserve target-mismatch controls such as the losing generic generated-JavaScript paths.
Approve a compiler campaign only after the dossier's public-call crossover evidence, exact oracle, fallback, and held-out generality obligations are complete.
